content:
We are happy to share a Lean (meta-)programming Cookbook. The effort to make this led by @Anirudh Gupta with @Ajay Kumar Nair contributing a lot. @Swarnava Chakraborty has also contributed to making this.

This is just the start and we hope to add much more. We are sharing in the hope that the community also adds recipes by making PRs to the Repository or just requesting more recipes.

About the cookbook

The idea of the cookbook is that in many cases, especially when it comes to meta-programming, what one is looking for is a specific "how to", essentially a static analogue to the channel Is there code for X? Specifically, I was inspired by Alvin Alexader's Scala Cookbook which I found extremely useful at another stage in my life.

There are many basic topics that are completely missing here - notably Widgets and the InfoTree. This is simply because none of us know much about this. Contributions are especially welcome for such topics.

Suggestions on what will make the cookbook more useful are also welcome. We used our judgement, which no doubt will sometimes turn out to be wrong.
